response: Saved Views is available today, giving you a faster way to return to the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on most. Instead of rebuilding a list from scratch every time, save the configuration once and reopen it with a single click. Saved Views is included in all paid plans, so every subscriber gets access at no extra cost. Each user can save up to 50 views, covering personal workflows, client work, or specific projects you check often. Views can also be shared with your team, making it easy to keep everyone aligned on the same priorities, sprint boards, or backlog filters without repeating setup work. Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, monitoring a sprint, or organizing work by owner, Saved Views helps your team spend less time configuring lists and more time getting things done together. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
